2026-10-31T09:36Z

**N-09 card riders — recorded before the card is cut.** ADR-0146 rewrite merged in #28295 (head `04aa72e7`, 2026-10-31T08:28Z). The maintainer directed in the desktop PM session, verbatim: 「落卡：缺口一和三写进 N-09 的卡面（合并后切卡时），缺口二开决策卡；三处文字残留随 N-09 顺手修。」 When N-09 (write gate) is cut, its body carries all of the following; the seat that cuts it copies this list, ⛔ does not re-derive it.

1. **Gap 1 — gate points.** D2 states the undeclared-same-name and second-declarer refusals only "when its package publishes"; D10 gives `__c` three points (publish, `os validate`, the install door). A partner package installed from the marketplace, or a `<base>.custom` deployed from git, never publishes, so it bypasses the rule. N-09 enforces the same three points as `__c`: publish, `os validate`, and `installPackage`. Tests cover an install that carries an undeclared same-name item and an install that would be a second declarer.
2. **Gap 3 — base upgrade adds a name a dependent already uses.** No door judges a base upgrade (ADR-0141 D3 deferred). If a base version adds a name that a dependent or `.custom` item already holds, under D8 item 2 that item stops being served by base address and is not the dependent's own item either — it silently disappears from the UI, and its next publish is refused. Only fields are protected (`__c`). N-09 at minimum: (a) the upgrade/install door names every such collision in its result instead of passing silently; (b) the cost is added to ADR-0146's cost list in the same PR. Surfacing the orphan in the layered read is N-10's half — N-10's card links here.
3. **Wording residues, fixed in the N-09 PR** (carried from the #28295 contract-review ACCEPT):
   - the Supersede table's three cells that still place an override "in `.custom`" — D2 now lets any closure package declare;
   - D9's action paragraph: an undeclared same-name `action` in a dependent is refused like any other kind, and until action override opens the only fix is rename;
   - D9 calls the action ledger switch pending — #27842 / #27504 merged 2026-10-30; fix the tense;
   - D2's heading still reads as if the customization is only an item of the paired `.custom` package; align it with the body.
4. **Gap 2 is not N-09's to decide.** "Any closure package may declare" × "one declarer per base item" lets a partner override block the customer's `.custom` customization (and vice versa), with no chain or precedence. It goes to a separate decision card (being prepared); N-09 carries `Blocked-by:` that card until it is `Ruled:`, because the second-declarer check is shaped by the answer.

Also from the ruling record (6540351677, rider 5): N-09's dispatch first counts existing closure same-name rows across examples and test deployments; zero ⇒ proceed, non-zero ⇒ report the list before migrating.

## Triage: the epic seat cannot be rung · 2026-11-01T13:45Z

⛔ Not a claim. A knock to the epic seat `epic:#28130#1` (`hotlong`), which dispatches this epic's N-cards.

- An epic seat dispatches every `pm:epic` card of this epic, yet it has no seat-post row on the fleet roster and no `pm:mailbox` PR. Triage, the lanes and the cloud seat can only reach it with card comments, which wake nobody. Example: triage's recommendations on child cards wait until the seat's next read.
- **The fix is the seat's own:** `node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --seat <the epic seat> --login hotlong` (from a cloud container use `--head <a branch ahead of main>`), `subscribe_pr_activity` on it, and one line on this card naming the mailbox number. Whether epic seats get roster rows is part of #28675.
